high_criteria: Deadleg branch present with Strouhal lock-in potential (v/D >= 20 s^-1)
medium_criteria: Side branch present but geometry not prone to acoustic resonance
low_criteria: No closed side branches or deadlegs

high_criteria: Pressure drop across valve/orifice with choked flow / sonic velocity (PWL >= 155 dB)
medium_criteria: High pressure drop valve with sub-critical flow (145 <= PWL < 155 dB)
low_criteria: No severe pressure drop or PWL < 145 dB

high_criteria: Connected directly to reciprocating compressor or positive displacement pump
medium_criteria: Connected to centrifugal machinery or skid with moderate vibration
low_criteria: Isolated / static piping with no vibrating equipment

medium_criteria: Reciprocating compressor/pump with standard pulsation bottle

high_criteria: Centrifugal compressor operated at low flow / recycle / near surge (< 70% BEP)
medium_criteria: Centrifugal compressor with stable continuous operating envelope

high_criteria: Fast acting valves (ESD, BDV, PCV, RV closure < 2L/c or fast opening)
medium_criteria: Automated control valves with moderate stroke speed

high_criteria: Liquid control valve/orifice with Sigma <= Sigma_critical or downstream flashing
medium_criteria: Moderate pressure drop with minor cavitation risk

high_criteria: Thermowell / sample probe with v >= v_critical (Scruton/Strouhal lock-in)
medium_criteria: Intrusive element with moderate velocity ratio
low_criteria: No intrusive elements or proven ASME PTC 19.3 TW pass

high_criteria: History of vibration fatigue failures on identical/similar system without verified redesign
medium_criteria: Known moderate vibration reported during walkdowns
low_criteria: Proven track record with zero vibration issues
